limitations: live-embedding float variance: some vectors in this atlas were embedded live rather than served from the embed cache. GPU inference is not bit-deterministic (kernel selection, reduction order, batch- and load-dependent code paths), so re-running this survey may produce vectors that differ at float precision, and downstream clustering can amplify such a difference into a different partition near a decision boundary. This atlas is the reproducibility boundary: everything derived from it is exact, everything upstream of it is approximate. See docs/design-notes/semantic-measurement.md.
